display.title: Episode 518: The Island of Treasures (Rosh Chodesh Adar Sheni)
display.summary_short: On the eve of Adar Sheni, Uncle Yossi explains the mitzvos of Purim, reads a letter about the Hakochainik march, welcomes two brothers in Studio 604, and tells the parable of the island of treasures.
display.summary_long: Broadcast just before Rosh Chodesh Adar Sheni in a leap year. Uncle Yossi explains why Purim is celebrated all over the world and reviews its mitzvos: hearing the Megillah night and day, the Purim seudah, mishloach manos of at least two foods, and extra tzedakah for the poor, with a prayer that Hashem bring Moshiach. Before the Hakochainik march he reads a listener's letter describing how her family marches around the table with a spoon and a teakettle. Two brothers recite the Shema in Studio 604 and talk about saying the Twelve Pesukim, and everyone gives tzedakah. Uncle Yossi then marks the yahrzeit of his mother on Beis Adar and tells 'The Island of Treasures': a shipwrecked man is crowned king of an island and spends its whole treasury beautifying it, only to learn he must leave as soon as the next castaway arrives, taking nothing with him. The island is this world, the treasures are the mitzvos, and this world is only a corridor to the World to Come. The show closes with Shabbos candle times.
display.lesson: This world is a corridor to the World to Come: use your time to learn Torah and do mitzvos, the only treasures you take with you.

date.note: 'Tomorrow night is Rosh Chodesh Adar Sheni, and this coming Shabbos is Beis Adar' fits Tuesday 3 March 1992 (Rosh Chodesh begins Wednesday night 4 March; Shabbos 7 March = 2 Adar II).

advisories.note: A ship sinks in a storm; only one man survives.
Yahrzeit of the host's mother; the soul's elevation in Gan Eden.
